commentDifference: // is for single-line comments ending at newline. /* and */ enclose multi-line block comments.
nestedComments: Block comments cannot be nested because the first closing delimiter */ terminates the entire comment block, causing a syntax error on the subsequent */.
preprocessorRole: Comments are stripped out by the preprocessor during stage 1 and replaced by a single whitespace character. They do not increase executable binary size.
docCommentExample:
/**
 * @brief Computes square of a number.
 * @param n Input integer.
 * @return Product of n * n.
 */
